targets.authors: Dussault, M., Hojjat, M., & Boone, R. T.
targets.title: Machiavellianism and dating: deception and intimacy.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study is a replication and an extension of Dussault, Hojjat, and Boone (2013).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, this study partially replicates the previous ﬁndings of (Dussault et al., 2013). The results conﬁrm a relationship between Machiavellianism and DMS, Machiavellianism and gender, and PI and HIB. However, no support was found for the previously reported relationship between PI and Machiavellianism, or PI and DMS, indicating that intimacy was not correlated with Machiavellianism or deceptive mating strategies.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude partial replication, with supported and unsupported relationships.

reasoning: New community participants retest the published Dussault et al. finding; other cited dating studies are background, and the Dark Triad analyses extend the target.
